text.style: line-height: normal; white-space: normal; text-transform: none;
text.tspan: Imports PDF receipts from selected files/folders into the existing receipts table. It OCRs each PDF using the documents tool, extracts
structured fields via an agent, checks duplicates (vendor+date+total+receipt_number), and supports two run modes: preview-only
(default) or automatic insert. It also supports configurable duplicate and missing-field handling, provides progress updates, uses batched
insertMany writes, and prints a clear summary with skipped/error files.

text.tspan: You extract receipt data from OCR text. Return only what can be supported by text. Amounts must be numeric. Dates
must be YYYY-MM-DD where possible. If uncertain, return null for that field.
